approved_payload.content: Police say they received a complaint that a woman was being assaulted by her male friend in Thusi Village; officers found her unconscious on the ground and paramedics declared her dead at the scene. A 31-year-old man still in the area was arrested on 2 October and charged with murder (police spokesperson Colonel Mavela Masondo, via Highvelder News). He appeared in the Ermelo Magistrate's Court and the case was postponed to 12 October for plea. The family is waiting for post-mortem results to confirm the cause of death. She is not named in the report. One report, resting on police: Highvelder News, 5 October. MAP POINT ESTIMATED: Thusi Village could not be placed on a map, so the pin sits on the Ermelo police station, in the area that dealt with the case. It is not the scene; the village may be up to about 44 km away.
